====================================================================
 Bit-accurate check of red_pitaya_acq_cic.v
====================================================================

1. DC GAIN (checks the output window is in the right place)
   R =    64:  output 3160320  expected 3160320   ok
   R =   128:  output 3160320  expected 3160320   ok
   R =   256:  output 3160320  expected 3160320   ok
   R =   512:  output 3160320  expected 3160320   ok
   R =  1024:  output 3160320  expected 3160320   ok
   R =  2048:  output 3160320  expected 3160320   ok
   R =  4096:  output 3160320  expected 3160320   ok
   PASS

2. INTEGRATOR WRAPAROUND (the overflow that is not a bug)
   R =    64:  256 decimated samples,  identical to unlimited-precision reference: True
   R =   512:  32 decimated samples,  identical to unlimited-precision reference: True
   R =  4096:  4 decimated samples,  identical to unlimited-precision reference: True
   (running total reached 30 bits; accumulators are 72 bits, and stage 4 grows far faster)
   PASS

3. FREQUENCY RESPONSE
   decimation R = 1024  ->  output rate 122.07 kSPS, measurement window +-61.04 kHz
   passband droop at +-30.52 kHz : -3.65 dB  (this is what the FIR filter corrects)
   worst alias reaching the passband      : -41.8 dB

   For reference, the same numbers for other stage counts:
     stages   droop(dB)   alias(dB)
       2         -1.82      -20.9
       3         -2.74      -31.4
       4         -3.65      -41.8  <- NSTAGE
       5         -4.56      -52.3

   More stages reject aliases harder but droop more. Four stages
   put the aliases well below the noise floor while leaving a droop
   small enough for the correction filter to flatten.
